description:
Can the visually impaired cook in a commercial kitchen, much less run a cafe? Alex Seow was a chef for over 10 years before he lost over 80% of his sight. Home cook Ernawati Fauzana Zakaria was born with glaucoma and has been partially sighted all her life. 

They're recruited by Aaron Yeoh, a first-time social entrepreneur with no F&B experience, who wants to prove that those with disabilities can chase their aspirations if given an inclusive workspace -- by setting up Kunyah Cafe at the Singapore Management University in downtown.

About the series:
"Our Blind Kitchen" follows the story of Alex, Aaron and their team as they navigate the challenges and opportunities of opening a cafe run by people with disabilities.
